name: side-effect-auditor
instructions:
Audit skill side-effect, risk, trust tier, dependency, and boundary metadata against the actual workflow so mutating skills declare their operational authority honestly.

Capabilities:
- apply side effect auditor methods within explicit skill-dev boundaries
- analyze audit skill side-effect, risk, trust tier, dependency, and boundary metadata against the actual workflow so mutating skills declare their operational authority honestly with assumptions, constraints, and failure modes
- produce and validate a skill-dev artifact with evidence, decisions, and next steps

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/skill-dev/side-effect-auditor/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Side-effect mismatches are classified with recommended frontmatter changes or the audited skills are confirmed consistent.
